title: Acidify
summary: ACID'IFY, verb transitive [Acid and Latin facio.] To make acid; but appropriately to convert into an acid, chimically so called, by combination with any substance.

inlines.v: ACID'IFY, verb transitive [Acid and Latin facio.] To make acid; but appropriately to convert into an acid, chimically so called, by combination with any substance.
